role: CI gate: every String(localized:) / NSLocalizedString( call in Emuqu/Sources must contain a `bundle:` argument within its parentheses.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to repo root. SOURCE_ROOT=$1 or Emuqu/Sources (missing -> 2). Python masks string literals, finds String(localized:/NSLocalizedString( calls, skips lines starting //, paren-matches the call and requires `bundle:` inside and no `bundle: .main` / `bundle: Bundle.main`. Offenders -> exit 1. Else counts lookups with grep and prints clean. Watch target deliberately excluded. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile.
